summary: Phase 4 continues the read-only PostgreSQL gear read-model split. server/pg_gear_read_model_selectors.py now owns build_season_recommended_catalog_candidates_by_slot_read_model(), which groups already-built catalog candidate items into season_recommendation candidate pools by slot while preserving legality filtering, uniqueness, sorting, and the 24-candidate limit. server/postgres_cache_store.py keeps PG SQL reads, active season reads, raw row cache, payload cache fingerprinting, cache writes, and sync/write/backfill paths.
